description: Golden set for Migration Autopilot. Each case is added-migration text plus the rule IDs we expect the engine to fire. An empty expect[] means the migration is SAFE and must produce zero findings (false-positive guard). Used by run-evals.ts to compute precision/recall/F1.

cases.name: drop column
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email;

cases.name: drop column if exists
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS email;

cases.name: drop table
cases.text: DROP TABLE legacy_orders;

cases.name: drop temp table is safe
cases.text: DROP TABLE temp_scratch;

cases.name: drop real temporary table
cases.text: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp_work;

cases.name: truncate
cases.text: TRUNCATE sessions;

cases.name: set not null
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN phone SET NOT NULL;

cases.name: add not null no default
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN age integer NOT NULL;

cases.name: add not null with constant default is safe
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN age integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

cases.name: add nullable column is safe
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN nickname text;

cases.name: change column type
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN id TYPE bigint;

cases.name: set data type variant
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN id SET DATA TYPE bigint;

cases.name: create index non-concurrent
cases.text: CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users (email);

cases.name: create unique index non-concurrent
cases.text: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_email ON users (email);

cases.name: create index concurrently safe (raw sql)
cases.text: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_email ON users (email);

cases.name: concurrently inside prisma txn
cases.text: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_email ON users (email);

cases.name: concurrently inside drizzle txn
cases.text: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx ON users (email);

cases.name: fk without not valid
cases.text: ALTER TABLE posts ADD CONSTRAINT fk_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id);

cases.name: fk with not valid is safe
cases.text: ALTER TABLE posts ADD CONSTRAINT fk_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) NOT VALID;

cases.name: check without not valid
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT chk_age CHECK (age >= 0);

cases.name: check with not valid is safe
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT chk_age CHECK (age >= 0) NOT VALID;

cases.name: validate constraint is safe
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT chk_age;

cases.name: unique constraint inline
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT uq_email UNIQUE (email);

cases.name: unique using index is safe
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT uq_email UNIQUE USING INDEX idx_users_email;

cases.name: rename column
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users RENAME COLUMN fname TO first_name;

cases.name: rename table
cases.text: ALTER TABLE clients RENAME TO customers;

cases.name: drop index non-concurrent
cases.text: DROP INDEX idx_old;

cases.name: drop index concurrently safe
cases.text: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_old;

cases.name: volatile default now()
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now();

cases.name: volatile default uuid
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN token uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();

cases.name: create table is safe
cases.text: CREATE TABLE teams (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());

cases.name: insert seed data is safe
cases.text: INSERT INTO roles (name) VALUES ('admin'), ('member');

cases.name: comment does not trigger drop
cases.text:
-- we will DROP COLUMN later, not now
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN note text;

cases.name: string literal does not trigger drop
cases.text: INSERT INTO audit (msg) VALUES ('DROP COLUMN email');

cases.name: two dangers one statement set + multi
cases.text:
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email;
ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN phone SET NOT NULL;

cases.name: mysql index not flagged by pg rule
cases.text: CREATE INDEX idx ON users (email);

cases.name: mysql drop column still data loss
cases.text: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email;

cases.name: prisma add not null no default
cases.text: ALTER TABLE "User" ADD COLUMN "age" INTEGER NOT NULL;

cases.name: prisma safe add optional
cases.text: ALTER TABLE "User" ADD COLUMN "bio" TEXT;

cases.name: rails remove_column
cases.text: remove_column :users, :email, :string

cases.name: rails change_column_null false
cases.text: change_column_null :users, :phone, false

cases.name: rails add_index
cases.text: add_index :users, :email

cases.name: rails add_index concurrently safe
cases.text: add_index :users, :email, algorithm: :concurrently

cases.name: rails add_foreign_key
cases.text: add_foreign_key :posts, :users

cases.name: rails add_foreign_key validate false safe
cases.text: add_foreign_key :posts, :users, validate: false

cases.name: rails rename_column
cases.text: rename_column :users, :fname, :first_name

cases.name: rails drop_table
cases.text: drop_table :legacy

cases.name: rails change_column type
cases.text: change_column :users, :id, :bigint

cases.name: rails add_column nullable safe
cases.text: add_column :users, :nickname, :string

cases.name: rails add_column not null no default
cases.text: add_column :users, :age, :integer, null: false
